question: The ‘International Satavadhanam’ program, launched virtually by the Vice President in November 2020 is related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Literature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **‘International ‘Satavadhanam’’** program, was launched virtually by the Vice President.
 
• ​He has observed that **‘Avadhanam’ as a literary feat** has greatly contributed to the **Telugu language’s glorious tradition**.
 
• It was organized by **Dr Medasani Mohan** under the auspices of **Sri Krishnadevaraya Satsang in Tirupati**.
 
• **Avadhānaṃ** is popular since ancient times and involves the **partial improvisation of poems using specific themes, metres, forms, or words**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Vice president** of India occupies **2nd highest office** in the country.

 
 
• He is **indirectly elected** by the **members of both houses of Parliament**.
 
• He acts as the **ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha**.
 
• He holds office for a term of** five years**.
 
• **Article 63** of the Indian Constitution describes the Vice-President of India.
